title: The Quantum Shortcut: Complex Phase-State Dynamics Reduce the Optimization Steps of Sequence Models
summary: Sequence models are conventionally distinguished by their backbone, the mechanism that routes information across positions, such as attention or recurrence. This paper varies a choice that is prior to the backbone and shared by nearly all current models: the \emph{substrate}, the number system in which the hidden state is represented together with the form of the map from state to prediction.
